Definition: Jishmajah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Ishmaiah is the name of two Israelites, a Gibeonite who joined David and a ruler of Zebulun. In 1 Chronicles 12:4, Ismaiah the Gibeonite. The fuller story is told on the Ishmaiah, Son of Obadiah profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that Ishmaiah is named at all, which tells me God sees individuals, not only crowds.
